amcm.insertion: last bottleneck module, before original decoder
amcm.token_policy: encoder-configured CLS/register prefix unchanged; only 28x28 patches processed

initialization: Fresh original pretrained DINOv2-register ViT-B/14; reinitialize reconstruction as V0 seed1, then construct official-default AMCM. No V0 trained checkpoint loading.
input: 512 full frame resized to 392; no spatial crop

validation.checkpoint_selection: maximum image AUROC; tie pixel AP
validation.threshold_selection: maximum validation image F1 per corresponding checkpoint

test.usage: after complete training, best validation checkpoint and reference final

evaluation: unchanged historical 256 evaluator, masks and top-1-percent image score; later corrected evaluator must re-evaluate V0 and V1 together
independent_checks: No smoke, subset training or short-run selection. Static source review only; full-run shape/gradient/finite-loss guards remain.
gpu_policy: Wait for GPU0 free >=14500 MiB; do not stop any existing job
publication_gate: Push this plan/code to specified branch, verify remote ref, create clean server checkout at that commit; runtime records commit. Independent DACL begins only after Bridge completes; no tuning or retries.
